LanguageData.AX_MAS_Settings_Enabled_Tip: Scale manually called allied military aid to the storyteller's current dynamic raid points.
LanguageData.AX_MAS_Settings_FollowThreatScale_Tip: On: target aid points = current dynamic raid points (adapts to colony wealth and progress, follows limits unlocked by other mods) × percent. Off: use a fixed factor instead.
LanguageData.AX_MAS_Settings_FloorAtVanillaMin_Tip: On: aid never falls below the vanilla minimum (800 points for point-based aid; the original headcount for fixed squads), preventing extremely small aid groups.
LanguageData.AX_MAS_Settings_DebugLogging_Tip: Print aid scaling details to the log on every call.
